description: Myrtle Essential Oil, sometimes called “Arrayan essential oil”, is derived from the Myrtus communis species of the myrtle plant. There are many different varieties of myrtle essential oil and each has its own set of uses. The best way, to distinguish which “myrtle” you are looking at, is to pay close attention to the botanical names. For example, Backhousia citriodora is lemon myrtle; whereas, Backhousia anisate is aniseed myrtle. Myrtus communis is the most common species of myrtle used, and within that species there are two varieties, red and green. Red myrtle contains more cineole and has a more “camphorous” aroma, while green myrtle contains more linalool. However, both varieties have the same calming effect and help ease anxiety and promote sleep.

description:
Plant Therapy Chamomile Roman (INCI Ingredients: Chamaemelum Nobile (Chamomile, Roman) Oil)
If you’re suffering from muscle/joint aches and pains, headaches, anxiety or just looking for a natural way to relax at night, then Plant Therapy Chamomile Roman is “just what the doctor ordered.” Chamomile Roman (Chamaemelum nobile) originates in the United Kingdom. It’s steam distilled and has a lovely sweet, "green," herbaceous apple-like aroma with a blue hue.

Many like to diffuse Chamomile Roman around bedtime to help fall asleep and get a great nights rest. You can also blend it with Peppermint, Bergamot, Chamomile German, Clary Sage, Geranium Egyptian, Lavender, Lemon and more to create a soothing body wash or homemade soap. Great for a relaxing nighttime bath too!

It’s not just for adults! This essential oil is KidSafe. It can help calm and soothe fussy babies, ease colic discomfort, and calm children that are throwing a temper tantrum. Please dilute properly before using with children.

We Work Directly With Top Experts. Robert Tisserand is a world renowned essential oil expert and educator. We have him organoleptically test each essential oil before it is sent to another third-party laboratory for Gas Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry (also known as GC/MS testing).

The Plant Therapy Difference:

100% Pure and Undiluted
USDA Certified Organic
Non-GMO
Organoleptic and GC/MS Testing
Batch Codes on Every Bottle

Certified Aromatherapists
Satisfaction Guarantee

We offer a vast selection of oils and blends in a variety of sizes. The 2.5 mL, 5 mL and 10 mL sizes are the perfect amount to test the waters. Our 30 mL bottle is a popular size for those that know just how well our oils work. The 100 mL value size is cost effective and easy on the budget. For ultimate convenience, try our handy Roll-Ons.

טיפול בצמחים קמומיל רומי (מרכיבי INCI: Chamaemelum Nobile (קמומיל, רומאי) שמן)
אם אתם סובלים מכאבי שרירים/מפרקים וכאבים, כאבי ראש, חרדה או פשוט מחפשים דרך טבעית להירגע בלילה, אז קמומיל הרומי לטיפול בצמחים הוא "בדיוק מה שהרופא הזמין ". קמומיל רומי (Chamaemelum nobile) מקורו בבריטניה. הוא מזוקק באדים ויש לו ניחוח מתוק "ירוק" דמוי תפוח עשבוני עם גוון כחול.

רבים אוהבים לפזר קמומיל רומי סביב שעת השינה כדי לעזור להירדם ולקבל מנוחה נהדרת בלילה. ניתן גם לשלב אותו עם מנטה, ברגמוט, קמומיל גרמני, מרווה מרווה, גרניום מצרי, לבנדר, לימון ועוד כדי ליצור סבון גוף מרגיע או סבון תוצרת בית. נהדר גם לאמבטיה מרגיעה לילה!

זה לא רק למבוגרים! שמן אתרי זה הוא KidSafe. זה יכול לעזור להרגיע ולהרגיע תינוקות בררניים, להקל על אי נוחות בכאבי בטן, ולהרגיע ילדים שזורקים התפרצות זעם. אנא לדלל כראוי לפני השימוש עם ילדים.

אנחנו עובדים ישירות עם מומחים מובילים. רוברט טיסרנד הוא מומחה ומומחה לשמנים אתריים הידוע בעולם. יש לנו אותו בודק באופן אורגני כל שמן אתרי לפני שהוא נשלח למעבדה של צד שלישי אחר עבור כרומטוגרפיה גז וספקטרומטריית המונים (הידוע גם בשם בדיקות GC/M).

Plant Therapy Kamille Roman (INCI Inhaltsstoffe: Chamaemelum Nobile (Kamille, Roman) Öl)
Wenn Sie unter Muskel- / Gelenkschmerzen und Schmerzen, Kopfschmerzen, Angstgefühlen oder einfach nur auf der Suche nach einer natürlichen Möglichkeit sind, sich nachts zu entspannen, dann ist Plant Therapy Kamille Roman "genau das, was der Arzt bestellt". Kamille Roman (Chamaemelum nobile) hat ihren Ursprung im Vereinigten Königreich. Es ist dampfdestilliert und hat einen schönen süßen, "grünen" krautigen Apfelduft mit einem blauen Farbton.

Viele verbreitet Kamille Römer gerne um das Schlafengehen herum, um beim Einschlafen zu helfen und eine tolle Nachtruhe zu bekommen. Sie können es auch mit Pfefferminze, Bergamotte, Deutscher Kamille, Muskatellersalbei, Geranie, Ägypter, Lavendel, Zitrone und mehr mischen, um eine beruhigende Körperwäsche oder hausgemachte Seife zu schaffen. Auch ideal für ein entspanntes Bad in der Nacht.

Nicht nur für Erwachsene! Dieses ätherische Öl ist KidSafe. Es kann helfen, wählerische Babys zu beruhigen und zu beruhigen, Kolik-Beschwerden zu lindern und Kinder zu beruhigen, die einen Temper-Wutanfall werfen. Bitte vor der Verwendung mit Kindern gut verdünnen.

Wir arbeiten direkt mit Top-Experten. Robert Tisserand ist ein weltweit renommierter Experte für ätherische Öle. Wir lassen jedes ätherische Öl organoleptisch testen, bevor es an ein anderes Drittlabor für Gaschromatographie und Massenspektrometrie (auch bekannt als GC/MS-Test).

بلانت ثيرابي البابونج الروماني (مكونات INCI): تشاميليوم نوبيل (البابونج والروماني)
إذا كنت تعاني من آلام العضلات/المفاصل أو الصداع أو القلق أو مجرد تبحث عن طريقة طبيعية للاسترخاء في الليل، فإن الرومان بالكاموميل من بلانت ثيرابي هو "ما طلبه الطبيب". يرجع أصل البابونج الروماني (تشاميليوم نوبيل) إلى المملكة المتحدة. إنه مقطر بالبخار وله رائحة لطيفة "خضراء" تشبه التفاح العشبي مع لون أزرق.

يحب الكثيرون نشر البابونج الروماني حول وقت النوم للمساعدة في النوم والحصول على راحة ليلية رائعة. يمكنك أيضًا مزجها بالنعناع والبرغموت والألمانية والبابونج والمريمية المتصلبة وإبرة الراعي المصري واللافندر والليمون وأكثر من ذلك لخلق غسول للجسم المهدئ أو صابون منزلي. رائعة للاستحمام الليلي المريح أيضًا!

ليس فقط للكبار! هذا الزيت العطري من كيد سيف. يمكن أن يساعد على تهدئة وتهدئة الأطفال المتألقين وتخفيف آلام المغص، وتهدئة الأطفال الذين يلقون غضب غضب غضب حرارة. يرجى تخفيفه بشكل صحيح قبل الاستخدام مع الأطفال.

نعمل مباشرة مع أفضل الخبراء. روبرت تيسراند، خبير ومعلم في الزيوت العطرية مشهور عالميًا. نجعله يقوم باختبار كل زيت عطري عضويًا قبل إرساله إلى مختبر آخر طرف ثالث لتنسيق الغاز وقياس الكتلة الطيفية (المعروف أيضًا باسم اختبار GC/MSM).

Plant Therapy Camomila Romana (Ingredientes INCI: Óleo de Chamaemelum Nobile (Camomila, Romano)
Se você está sofrendo de dores musculares/articulares, dores de cabeça, ansiedade ou apenas procurando uma maneira natural de relaxar à noite, então a camomila romana da Plant Therapy é "exatamente o que o médico pediu". A camomila romana (Chamaemelum nobile) tem origem no Reino Unido. É destilado a vapor e tem um adorável aroma doce e "verde", herbáceo como maçã com um tom azul.

Muitos gostam de difundir camomila romana na hora de dormir para ajudar a adormecer e ter uma ótima noite de descanso. Você também pode misturar com hortelã, bergamota, camomila alemã, sálvia esclareia, gerânio egípcio, lavanda, limão e mais para criar um sabonete corporal calmante ou caseiro. Ótimo para um banho noturno relaxante também!

Não é apenas para adultos! Este óleo essencial é KidSafe. Pode ajudar a acalmar bebês agitados, aliviar o desconforto das cólicas e acalmar crianças que estão jogando uma birra temperada. Dilua adequadamente antes de usar com crianças.

Trabalhamos diretamente com os melhores especialistas. Robert Tisserand é um especialista e educador de óleos essenciais de renome mundial. 許多人喜歡在睡前將洋甘菊羅馬人散播,以幫助入睡,享受美好的夜晚休息。 您還可以將其與薄荷、佛手柑、德國洋甘菊、鼠尾草、天竺葵、薰衣草、檸檬等混合,打造舒緩的沐浴或自製肥皂。 也非常適合夜間沐浴!

It’s ultra-versatile and has many uses. Cypress has a beautiful spicy, slightly woody fresh scent that is made by steam distilling leaves from Cypress trees in Spain.Cypress is great for helping to support a healthy respiratory system all year long. Whether you’re dealing with allergies or it’s cold/flu season, Cypress is here to help. Diffuse to help clear sinuses or make a natural topical decongestant and apply to chest for even more relief.

The soothing, uplifting aroma of Cypress can help you when times are tough or you’re down in the dumps. Take some deep inhales of the herbaceous, fresh scent and start feeling a wave of calm throughout your body.

Cypress can be useful for certain skin issues such as acne. It has anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and astringent properties making it helpful for oily, blemish prone skin. It can also be used for Varicose Veins, in a 2-3% dilution apply to the impacted area 2-3 times daily.

We Work Directly With Top Experts. Robert Tisserand is a world renowned essential oil expert and educator. We have him organoleptically test each essential oil before it is sent to another third-party laboratory for Gas Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry (also known as GC/MS testing).

The Plant Therapy Difference:
• 100% Pure and Undiluted, USDA Certified Organic, Non-GMO
• Organoleptic and GC/MS Testing
• Batch Codes on Every Bottle
We offer a vast selection of oils and blends in a variety of sizes. The 2.5 mL, 5mL and 10 mL sizes are the perfect amount to test the waters. Our 30 mL bottle is a popular size for those that know just how well our oils work. The 100 mL value size is cost effective and easy on the budget. For ultimate convenience, try our ready-to-use Roll-Ons.

Ätherisches Öl für die Pflanzentherapie (INCI Inhaltsstoffe: Cupressus Sempervirens Blattöl) Zypresse ist eines der beliebtesten ätherischen Öle, die von Plant Therapy angeboten werden. Es ist ultra-vielseitig und hat viele Verwendungsmöglichkeiten. Die Zypresse hat einen schönen würzigen, leicht holzigen, frischen Duft, der durch Dampfdestillation von Blättern von Zypressenbäumen in Spanien hergestellt wird. Die Zypresse ist ideal für die Unterstützung einer gesunden Atemwege das ganze Jahr über. Egal, ob Sie mit Allergien umgehen oder es sich um eine Erkältungs- / Grippesaison handelt, die Zypresse hilft Ihnen dabei. Diffuse to help clear nebenhöhlen or make a natural topical decongestant and apply to chest for even more relief

Das beruhigende, erhebende Aroma von Zypresse kann Ihnen helfen, wenn die Zeiten hart sind oder sich in den Deponien befinden. Nehmen Sie einige tiefe Inhalate des krautigen, frischen Duftes und beginnen Sie eine Welle der Ruhe im ganzen Körper.

Zypresse kann bei bestimmten Hautproblemen wie Akne nützlich sein. Es hat entzündungshemmende, antibakterielle und adstringierende Eigenschaften, wodurch es hilfreich für fettige, unreine Haut ist. Es kann auch bei Krampfadern verwendet werden, in einer 2-3% Verdünnung auf den betroffenen Bereich 2-3 mal täglich auftragen.

Wir arbeiten direkt mit Top-Experten. Robert Tisserand ist ein weltweit renommierter Experte für ätherische Öle. Wir lassen jedes ätherische Öl organoleptisch testen, bevor es an ein anderes Drittlabor für Gaschromatographie und Massenspektrometrie (auch bekannt als GC/MS-Test).

The Plant Therapy Difference:
• 100 % rein und unverdünnt, USDA-zertifiziert, organisch, ohne Gentechnik.
• Organoleptikum und GC/MS-Tests.
• Chargen-Codes auf jeder Flasche.
Wir bieten eine große Auswahl an Ölen und Mischungen in einer Vielzahl von Größen. Die Größen von 2,5 ml, 5 ml und 10 ml sind die perfekte Menge, um das Wasser zu testen. Unsere 30-ml-Flasche ist eine beliebte Größe für diejenigen, die wissen, wie gut unsere Öle funktionieren. Die 100 ml Wertgröße ist kostengünstig und einfach im Budget. Probieren Sie unsere gebrauchsfertigen Roll-Ons für ultimativen Komfort aus.

שמן אתרי ברוש (רכיבי INCI: שמן עלים Cupressus Sempvirens) הוא אחד השמנים האתריים הפופולריים ביותר המוצעים על ידי Plant Therapy, ומסיבה טובה. הוא רב-תכליתי במיוחד ויש לו שימושים רבים. לברוש יש ניחוח חריף ועצי רענן ויפה שנעשה על ידי עלי זיקוק קיטור מעצי ברוש בספרד. ברוש נהדר לסיוע במערכת נשימה בריאה לאורך כל השנה. בין אם אתם מתמודדים עם אלרגיות או עונת הצטננות/שפעת, ברוש כאן כדי לעזור. הפזר כדי לעזור לנקות את הסינוסים או לעשות חומר נוגד גודש מקומי טבעי ולמרוח על החזה להקלה אפילו יותר.

הניחוח המרגיע והמרומם של ברוש יכול לעזור לכם כאשר הזמנים קשים או שאתם נמצאים במצבאות. קחו כמה שאיפות עמוקות של הריח העשני, הרענן והתחילו להרגיש גל של שלווה בכל הגוף שלכם.

ברוש יכול להיות שימושי עבור בעיות עור מסוימות כגון אקנה. יש לו תכונות אנטי דלקתיות, אנטיבקטריאליות וחריפות מה שהופך אותו למועיל לעור שמנוני, נוטה לפגמים. הוא יכול לשמש גם עבור דליות ורידים, בדילול של 2-3% חל על האזור הפגוע 2-3 פעמים ביום.

אנחנו עובדים ישירות עם מומחים מובילים. רוברט טיסרנד הוא מומחה ומומחה לשמנים אתריים הידוע בעולם. יש לנו אותו בודק באופן אורגני כל שמן אתרי לפני שהוא נשלח למעבדה של צד שלישי אחר עבור כרומטוגרפיה גז וספקטרומטריית המונים (הידוע גם בשם בדיקות GC/M).

ההבדל בטיפול בצמחים:
• 100% טהור ולא מדולל, מאושר על ידי משרד החקלאות האמריקאי אורגני, לא מהונדס גנטית
• בדיקת אורגנולפטית ו- GC/MS
• קודי אצווה על כל בקבוק
אנו מציעים מבחר עצום של שמנים ותערובות במגוון גדלים. הגדלים של 2.5 מ"ל, 5 מ"ל ו-10 מ"ל הם הכמות המושלמת כדי לבדוק את המים. בקבוק 30 מ"ל שלנו הוא בגודל פופולרי עבור אלה שיודעים עד כמה טוב השמנים שלנו עובדים. גודל הערך של 100 מ"ל הוא חסכוני וקל על התקציב. לנוחות אולטימטיבית, נסו את ה-Roll-Ons המוכנים לשימוש שלנו.

زيت السيبرس العطري من بلانت ثيرابي (مكونات INCI: زيت أوراق نبات الكوبريسوس سيمبرفيرنز ) السرو هو أحد أكثر الزيوت العطرية شعبية التي تقدمها بلانت ثيرابي ولأسباب وجيهة. إنه متعدد الاستخدامات للغاية وله العديد من الاستخدامات. يتميز السرو برائحة جميلة وخشبية منعشة قليلاً مصنوعة بواسطة تقطير أوراق شجر السرو بالبخار في إسبانيا. السرو رائع للمساعدة في دعم الجهاز التنفسي الصحي طوال العام. سواء كنت تعاني من الحساسية أو موسم البرد أو الإنفلونزا، فإن سايبرس هنا للمساعدة. انشره للمساعدة في تنظيف الجيوب الأنفية أو عمل مزيل للاحتقان الموضعي الطبيعي وضعه على الصدر لمزيد من الراحة.

يمكن أن تساعدك رائحة السيبرس المهدئة والمنعشة عندما تكون الأوقات قاسية أو في النفايات. خذ بعض الاستنشاق العميق من الرائحة العشبية المنعشة وابدأ في الشعور بموجة من الهدوء في جميع أنحاء جسمك.

السرو يمكن أن يكون مفيدًا لمشاكل معينة في البشرة مثل حب الشباب. يتميز بخصائص مضادة للالتهابات والبكتيريا وقابضة مما يجعله مفيدًا للبشرة الدهنية المعرضة للشوائب. يمكن استخدامه أيضًا للدوالي الوريدية، في وضع تخفيف 2-3% على المنطقة المتضررة 2-3 مرات يوميًا.

نعمل مباشرة مع أفضل الخبراء. روبرت تيسراند، خبير ومعلم في الزيوت العطرية مشهور عالميًا. نجعله يقوم باختبار كل زيت عطري عضويًا قبل إرساله إلى مختبر آخر طرف ثالث لتنسيق الغاز وقياس الكتلة الطيفية (المعروف أيضًا باسم اختبار GC/MSM).

اختلاف العلاج النباتي:
• نقي 100% وغير مخفف، عضوي معتمد من وزارة الزراعة الأمريكية، غير معدل وراثياً.
• اختبار الحواس والغاز/القياس الكتلي
• ادفع الرموز على كل زجاجة.
نقدم مجموعة واسعة من الزيوت والخلطات بأحجام مختلفة. الأحجام 2.5 مل و5 مل و10 مل هي الكمية المثالية لاختبار الماء. زجاجة 30 مل الخاصة بنا ذات حجم شائع لأولئك الذين يعرفون مدى عمل زيوتنا. حجم القيمة 100 مل فعال من حيث التكلفة وسهل في التكلفة. للحصول على أقصى درجات الراحة، جرّب منتجاتنا الدوارة الجاهزة للاستخدام.

O óleo essencial de cipreste da Plant Therapy (ingredientes INCI: Óleo de folha de Cupressus Sempervirens) O cipreste é um dos óleos essenciais mais populares oferecidos pela Plant Therapy e por um bom motivo. É ultra versátil e tem muitos usos. O cipreste tem um belo aroma picante e ligeiramente amadeirado que é feito com folhas de destilação a vapor de cipreste na Espanha. O cipreste é ótimo para ajudar a apoiar um sistema respiratório saudável durante todo o ano. Se você estiver lidando com alergias ou está na estação fria/gripe, o cipreste está aqui para ajudar. Difunda para ajudar a clarear os seios nasais ou fazer um descongestionante tópico natural e aplique no peito para ainda mais alívio.

O aroma calmante e revigorante do cipreste pode ajudar você quando os tempos estiverem difíceis ou você estiver no lixo. Tire algumas profundas inalações do aroma herbáceo e fresco e comece a sentir uma onda de calma em todo o seu corpo.

O cipreste pode ser útil para certos problemas de pele como acne. Tem propriedades anti-inflamatórias, antibacterianas e adstringentes, o que o torna útil para peles oleosas e propensas a manchas. Também pode ser usado para varizes, em uma diluição de 2 a 3%, aplique na área afetada 2 a 3 vezes ao dia.

Trabalhamos diretamente com os melhores especialistas. Robert Tisserand é um especialista e educador de óleos essenciais de renome mundial. Fazemos com que ele teste organolepticamente cada óleo essencial antes de ser enviado para outro laboratório de terceiros de cromatografia a gás e espectrometria de massa (também conhecido como teste GC/MS).

A diferença da Plant Therapy:
• 100% puro e não diluído, certificado orgânico USDA, sem OGM
• Testes organolépticos e GC/MS
• Códigos de lote em cada garrafa
Oferecemos uma vasta seleção de óleos e misturas em uma variedade de tamanhos. Os tamanhos de 2,5 ml, 5 ml e 10 ml são a quantidade perfeita para testar as águas. Nosso frasco de 30 ml tem um tamanho popular para aqueles que sabem o quão bem nossos óleos funcionam. O valor de 100 ml é econômico e fácil de usar no orçamento. Para a máxima conveniência, experimente nossos Roll-On prontos para usar.

Plant Therapy 柏樹精油(INCI 成分:Cupressus Sempervirens Leaf Oil) 柏樹是 Plant Therapy 提供最受歡迎的精油之一,有很好的理由。 超多功能,用途廣泛。 Cypress 有一種美麗的辛辣、微木清新香味,由西班牙柏樹蒸餾葉製成。Cypress 非常適合全年維持健康的呼吸系統。 無論您是應對過敏或寒冷 / 流感季節,Cypress 隨時為您提供協助。 擴散以幫助清除鼻竇或形成自然局部減充血劑,並塗抹在胸部以得到更多緩解。

Cypress 的舒緩、令人振奮的香氣可以幫助您在時間緊張或您在垃圾桶中。 吸收一些強烈的草本清新香味,開始感覺整個身體平靜。 ​

Cypress 可以用於某些皮膚問題,如痤瘡。 它具有抗炎、抗菌和收腰特性,有助於油性、易產生瑕疵的肌膚。 它也可以用於靜脈曲張,稀釋 2-3% 適用於受影響區域,每天 2-3 次。

我們直接與頂級專家合作。 Robert Tisserand 是世界知名的精油專家和教育家。 我們讓他對每種精油進行器官測試,然後再送至另一個第三方實驗室進行氣相色譜和質譜 (也稱為 GC/MS 測試)。

植物療法的不同之處:
• 100% 純淨未稀釋,USDA 認證有機,非轉基因
• 器官和 GC/MS 測試
• 每個瓶子上的批碼
我們提供各種尺寸的精油和混合物。 2.5 毫升、5 毫升和 10 毫升的尺寸是測試水的完美量。 我們的 30 毫升瓶是一款熱門尺寸,適合那些知道精油運作狀況的人。 100 毫升的尺寸經濟實惠,價格實惠。 為了極致方便,請試試我們隨時可用的Roll-On。

Plant Therapy 柏树精油(INCI 成分:Cupressus Sempervirens 叶油)柏树是Plant Therapy所提供的广受欢迎的精油之一。 超百搭,用途广泛。 柏树有一种美丽辛辣,微木香的清香,由西班牙柏树的蒸汽蒸馏叶制成。柏树有助于全年保持健康的呼吸系统。 无论您是面对过敏还是感冒/流感季节,Cypress 都能为您提供帮助。 扩散以帮助清除鼻窦或制作天然局部脱血剂,并涂抹在胸部,以获得更多缓解。

Cypress 舒缓、令人振奋的香气可以帮助您在时光艰难或您进入水槽时为您提供帮助。 深吸一些草本清新的香味,开始在整个身体中感受平静的波浪。

柏树对某些皮肤问题有帮助。 它具有抗炎、抗菌和收敛特性,有助于油性、易长痘的皮肤。 它还可以用于静脉曲张,2-3% 的稀释剂在受影响区域每天 2-3 次。

我们直接与顶级专家合作。 Robert Tisserand 是世界著名的精油专家和教育家。 在送到另一个第三方实验室进行气体色谱和质量光谱测量(也称 GC/MS 测试)之前,我们让他有机地测试每一种精油。

植物治疗的与众不同之处:
• 100% 纯和未稀释,USDA Organic 认证,非转基因
• 有机和 GC/MS 测试
• 每瓶的批次代码
我们提供各种尺寸的油和混合物。 2.5 毫升、5 毫升和 10 毫升的尺寸是测试水份的完美量。 对于那些知道我们油工作质量的人来说,我们的 30 毫升瓶是一种受欢迎的尺寸。 100 毫升的超值尺寸经济实惠,预算更简单。 为了获得极致便利,请尝试我们随时可用的滚珠。

플랜트 테라피 사이프러스 에센셜 오일 (INCI 성분: Cupressus Sempervirens 잎 오일) 사이프러스는 플랜트 테라피가 제공하는 가장 인기 있는 에센셜 오일 중 하나이며, 좋은 이유가 있습니다. 매우 다재다능하며 많은 용도가 있습니다. 사이프러스는 스페인의 사이프러스 나무의 증기로 잎을 증류하여 만든 아름답고 매운 약간 우디한 신선한 향기를 가지고 있습니다. 사이프러스는 일 년 내내 건강한 호흡기 시스템을 지원하는 데 좋습니다. 알레르기를 겪거나 추위/독감 시즌에 상관없이 사이프러스가 도와드리겠습니다. 부비동을 없애거나 자연스러운 국소 충혈 완화제를 만들고 가슴에 바르면 더욱 완화됩니다.

사이프러스의 진정 효과가 있는 향은 시간이 힘들거나 덤프를 할 때 도움이 됩니다. 초본의 신선한 향기를 깊게 들으며 몸 전체에 차분한 물결을 느끼기 시작하십시오.

사이프러스는 여드름과 같은 특정 피부 문제에 유용합니다. 항염증, 항균 및 수렴 기능이 있어 지성 및 잡티가 많은 피부에 유용합니다. 또한 정맥류에도 사용할 수 있습니다. 2-3% 희석하여 손상된 부위에 매일 2-3번 바르세요.

우리는 최고의 전문가들과 직접 일합니다. Robert Tisserand는 세계적으로 유명한 에센셜 오일 전문가이자 교육자입니다. 우리는 가스 크로마토그래피 및 질량 분광 측정(GC/MS 테스트라고도 함)을 위해 다른 제3자 실험실로 보내기 전에 각 에센셜 오일을 관능적으로 테스트했습니다.

식물 치료의 차이점:
• 100% 순수 및 희석되지 않은 USDA 인증 유기농, GMO 프리.
• Organoleptic 및 GC/MS 테스트
• 모든 병에 배치 코드
저희는 다양한 크기의 오일 및 블렌드를 광범위하게 선택할 수 있습니다. 2.5 mL, 5 mL 및 10 ml 사이즈는 물을 테스트하기에 완벽한 양입니다. 저희 30mL 병은 오일의 효과가 얼마나 잘 알고 있는 사람들에게 인기 있는 크기입니다. 100mL 값 사이즈는 비용 효율적이며 예산에 부담이 없습니다. 최상의 편의를 위해 바로 사용할 수 있는 롤온을 사용해보세요.

Many know of Frankincense as one of the plant-derived treasures, along with myrrh, given to the newborn Jesus in the New Testament. Its use in a religious context goes beyond Christianity, however. description:
Organic blue chamomile oil is extracted from an annual plant with erected stems and alternate leaves divided in thin lashes, thicker and wider than those of Roman Chamomile, and 40 – 60 cm high. The oil is produced by water steam distillation with an average yield of 0.1%. This plant is native to the Balkans, and has been used in shampoos since the days of the Vikings, because it adds luster to the blond hair. It used to be cultivated in Hungary an exported to Germany to be distilled and used under tea form. Chamazulene, a strong anti-inflammatory compound, is produced during the distillation through the conversion of a sesquiterpene lactone called “Matricin”. It confers the characteristic blue color to the oil. The Oil is a deep blue liquid (sometimes viscous) with a strong medicinal, phenolic, sweet and fruity odor.  Its apple aroma is the characteristic fragrance in many herbal skin-care products, and it is the reason why this plant is called “Manzanilla” in Spain.  The high Bisabolol chemotypes are preferred for therapy and cosmetic uses, due to the activity of this sesquiterpene alcohol.

description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

Directions for Use:

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

Cautions:

If pregnant, nursing or under a doctor’s care, consult the physician. Discontinue use if skin sensitivity occurs. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use undiluted on the skin. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin or on abrasions.

IMPORTANT: All of our products are for external use only.

Packing:

Gardenia Oil available in 8 packing options (5ml, 10ml, 15ml, 30ml, 50ml, 100ml, 250ml & 1000ml) which is Packed in Dark Colored Amber Glass Bottle (5ml - 100ml) with Euro Dropper, whereas 250ml,500ml & 1000ml comes in Aluminum Bottle.

description:
Ginger has been regarded as an indispensable food and medication by many races.

In Taiwan, it's the spice and seasoning most commonly seen in the household; it's also one of the most prevalent herbal medicines.

Ginger has a feature of giving off warmth and is easily absorbed during digestion, so it's often used to help resist chilling weather and to nourish the body.

The plantation of ginger needs to strictly focus organic cultivation and the rehabilitation of soil.

Ginger's full growing season is 10 months.

During the growing period, it absorbs large amounts of nutrients from the soil, and is a crop that consumes a lot of farm land.

Consequently, after the harvest of ginger, the land must go through the process of rehabilitation for the next plantation.

During the planting process, many farmers will use chemical pesticides and chemical fertilizers only for their convenience.

That method prepares the land for crops for a year, but it takes 3-5 years or more time to eliminate all the chemical ingredients and help the land regain nutrients.

It’s a method that causes the waste of land production , water loss and soil erosion; furthermore, the chemicals can’t be removed completely from the soil.

On the contrary, ginger farms cultivating through organic methods and fertilizing with organic vegetables, also strictly choose germ-free ginger species.

The farm land goes through a time-consuming plantation process, including exposure in the sun, water control management, and manual checks, so that without wasting the farm land, the annual harvest reaches a high quality, and the ginger has sufficient nutrients.

However, the cost or organic plantation is much higher than traditional agricultural methods.

description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

What is Frankincense?

Many know of Frankincense as one of the plant-derived treasures, along with myrrh, given to the newborn Jesus in the New Testament. Its use in a religious context goes beyond Christianity, however. According to the Hebrew Bible, frankincense and myrrh were components of the holy incense ritually burned in Jerusalem’s sacred temples during ancient times.

Frankincense is derived from the sap from a specific variety of trees in the genus Boswellia. Harvests are done at various times and the more opaque resins are considered to be the best quality.

Benefits of Frankincense oil

    The main chemical of Frankincense oil constituents of the essential oil are Limonene, Pinene, Borneol, Farnesol, Phellandrene, Myrcene, and other constituents. description:
Sandalwood has an admirable status in eastern history.

High-quality Sandalwood is used for Buddhist sculptures, producing Buddhist prayer beads, and is taken as the material in building temples.

It's also burnt to worship God.

It has the meaning of admiration to God and spirits, and it implies eternity.

Inside the temple when monks are meditating, they burn Sandalwood during meditation for better soaking in Zen status.

In the palaces of ancient China, Sandalwood was appreciated by the nobles, and taken as the material for the production of high-class furniture, utensils and musical instruments.

During important occasions and rituals, Sandalwood was burnt to scent the environment.

Sandalwood grows very slowly, it takes tens of years to grow the bullet, the center of the trunk, so as to be extracted for high-quality Sandalwood essential oil.

In India Ayurveda, it records the precious medicinal effects of Sandalwood essential oil.

Indians call Sandalwood the panacea (miraculous cure) left in the human world by the Gods. Besides this, it also has a beautiful name, liquid gold.

In the past, the major origin of Sandalwood was in east India. But due to overharvesting and illegal smuggling, the number of wild Sandalwood trees has dropped immensely.

At present, the Indian government has strict control over the export of Sandalwood essential oil.

Currently, the major place of production of Sandalwood is aggregated in Australia.

The Australian government has plantation plans and management for stabilizing quality. Consisting of multiple components, Sandalwood essential oil gets a richer scent over time, and now it's the major source of high-quality sandalwood.

What is Frankincense?

Many know of Frankincense as one of the plant-derived treasures, along with myrrh, given to the newborn Jesus in the New Testament. Its use in a religious context goes beyond Christianity, however. According to the Hebrew Bible, frankincense and myrrh were components of the holy incense ritually burned in Jerusalem’s sacred temples during ancient times.

Frankincense is derived from the sap from a specific variety of trees in the genus Boswellia. Harvests are done at various times and the more opaque resins are considered to be the best quality.

Benefits of Frankincense oil

    The main chemical of Frankincense oil constituents of the essential oil are Limonene, Pinene, Borneol, Farnesol, Phellandrene, Myrcene, and other constituents. Limonene demonstrates antioxidant, anti-inflammatory those are believed to reduce feelings of anxiety and to stimulate the immune system. Used topically and cosmetically, its astringent and cytophylactic qualities help Frankincense oil to reduce the appearance of wrinkles and skin imperfections such as discoloration. 100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

Oil Applications:

  • Direct Inhalation
    Put 3 or 4 drops of essential oil onto a tissue or handkerchief and gently inhale. Alternatively, simply inhale directly from the bottle.
  • Steam Inhalation
    Fill a large container with almost boiling water and add 4-5 drops of essential oil or essential oil blend. Lean over the bowl and breathe slowly and deeply for a few minutes until relief is felt. 
  • Vaporize/Diffuse
    For the Ultra Sonic Essential Oil Diffusers, add water to the internal chamber and add 4-8 drops of essential oil(s).
  • Bath
    Use 8 drops of essential oil per 10mls carrier oil to ensure the essential oils are dispersed throughout the water.
  • Massage
    If making your own massage oil blend 5-10 drops of essential oil into 10 mls carrier oil. 

Essential oil is a natural product extracted from a single plant species. Not all plants produce essential oils, and in the plants that do, the essential oil may be found in the roots, stems, leaves, flowers, or fruits. Unique aromatic compounds give each essential oil its characteristic essence. Essential oils are concentrated plant extracts that retain the natural smell and flavor, or "essence," of their source.

Doctors agree it can help your skin stay soft, smooth and moisturized, and prevent it from being dehydrated and from cracking. We are able to offer you this high quality oil sold sometimes for over $200 per 15ml for a fraction of that cost because we are the distillery and work directly with the family farmers in the region. Our oil is not adulterated in any way and the quality speaks for itself when you smell and use it. You have three options to choose from when you want to use helichrysum oil: Aromatically: Add four drops to a diffuser or into your steam bath. Topically: Mix a few drops with a carrier oil like coconut or jojoba oil or add to a cream, facial serum or lotion. It may also be used on wounds to help speed up the healing process but test the oil first on your skin to see how sensitive you are to it's powers as you may want to water it down first. Internally: Dilute one drop in four ounces of liquid. There are no known side effects of helichrysum oil, but avoid contact with sensitive areas like the eyes since it can cause irritation. Spearmint essential oil contains at least 50% carvone, a chemical compound that brings to the spearmint that so characteristic taste and odor. It is therefore natural that the main use of the spearmint essential oil is an aroma for the food, pharmaceutical, cosmetics and perfume industries.

At home, it is easy and safe to add the spearmint essential oil to homemade preparations such as beverages, syrups, desserts, cakes and household products.

Refreshing and relaxing

Spearmint essential oil is particularly recommended to treat nervousness, fatigue, stress, anxieties, emotional shocks and depression. Carvone and its refreshing effect stimulates brain activity. On the other hand, limonene and its relaxing properties help to relax nerves and muscles.

How to use

The healthiest way to use this essential oil is in diffusion, inhalation or olfaction. Strongly dilute the essential oil in water (10% maximum).

As with many essential oils, spearmint essential oil should not be used for long periods of time, maximum 15 days.

In massage, add 5 to 10 drops to a carrier oil, such as coconut oil or olive oil. Do not apply to a large part of the body. Do not apply undiluted directly to the skin.

The use of natural essential oils for aromatherapy is an ancient and time-honored tradition that’s been enhancing moods and lifting spirits for thousands of years. Essential oils are liquid plant essences that are genuine reflections of the botanicals from which they’re born. Our ingredients consist of 100% pure and certified organic lavender oil only, created through a natural distillation process, offering the purest and most potent natural essential oil available. Natural essential oils are highly concentrated and should be used with care. When your head feels THIS big try Head Ease Blend: Add 3 drops each of lavender oil, peppermint oil and chamomile oil to a diffuser and enjoy.

Nuestros ingredientes consisten en aceite de lavanda orgánico 100% puro y certificado, creado a través de un proceso de destilación natural, ofreciendo el aceite esencial natural más puro y potente disponible. Natürliche ätherische Öle sind hochkonzentriert und sollten mit Sorgfalt verwendet werden. description:
Description:

Scientific Name: Abelmoschus esculentus

Okra is a flowering plant that has been originated in India and various English speaking countries. It is also known as bhindi, lady’s fingers and bhendi. Botanically, it is called Abelmoschus esculentus and belongs to the family Malvaceae. It is mostly prized for the seed pods it produces. Okra has high content of Vitamin C, A, iron and calcium. The seeds of Okra are striated; hairy and round that could be used for oil extraction. In 1920, Baughman and Jamaienson analyzed that the seeds have 20% of oil so Solvent extraction method is suitable to extract oil instead of expelling. The resulted oil is bright yellow in color having a greenish tinge and a fragrant odor. This oil possesses Gama and Alfa tocopherols along with triglycerides. It is an excellent source of linoleic acid which is a polyunsaturated fatty acid that is a required nutrition for humans.

DESCRIPTION: Moments of stillness and peace can elude us when anxiety comes barging in and causes us to get stuck in our heads, lost in nervousness. It's estimated that nearly 40 percent of adults suffer from anxiety of some kind according to the Anxiety and Depression Association of America. Anxiety Ease was formulated to help calm the tension of stress and anxiousness. We can steal back those moments of clarity and confidence by slowing down and inhaling a few drops of Anxiety Ease. At Edens Garden, we hope that if you are suffering from anxiety that you seek help and let Anxiety Ease work as a tool in your life to find lasting peace. A balanced mixture of Lemongrass, Sweet Orange and Ylang Ylang. Made with care from our top quality oils and, as always, Edens Garden essential oils are never diluted or mixed with additives. CONTAINS: Lemongrass, Sweet Orange and Ylang Ylang BE INSPIRED: Stressful moments are soothed and loud days are pacified by simply inhaling a few drops of Anxiety Ease. Also try placing 10 drops of Anxiety Ease in a foot soak to relieve tired feet.

Die gute Nachricht ist, dass wir nicht allein sind und wir können Möglichkeiten erstellen, Stress abzubauen. Es wird geschätzt, dass fast 40 Prozent der Erwachsenen unter Angstzuständen einer Art leiden, laut der Vereinigung von Amerika. Anxiety Ease wurde entwickelt, um die Spannung von Stress und Angst zu lindern. Wir können diese Momente der Klarheit und des Selbstbewusstseins zurückstehlen, indem wir ein paar Tropfen Angstlinderung verlangsamen. description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

Directions for Use:

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

Cautions:

IMPORTANT: All of our products are for external use only.

Undiluted and with absolutely no additives or fillers, this blend has a vibrant and fresh slightly herbaceous scent.

SUPPORTS THE IMMUNE SYSTEM Show Ready was created to keep your dogs and horses healthy. Dogs and horses become more susceptible to illness and disease during times of travel, stress, when being boarded for long periods of time, or when exposed to other ill animals. This blend utilizes essential oils that will help to support the immune system and offer protection from illness.

EASY TO USE Diffuse using 1-2 drops per 100 mL of water for 5-10 minutes every few hours. Passive diffusion is also a great option. Try adding 1-2 drops to a cotton ball and tucking that cotton ball into your dog’s bed. For topical application dilute to 0.25-2% depending on your animal's species and weight. Apply the diluted blend to the chest or back of neck 1-2 times daily during those times when your animals are more susceptible to illness.

CREATE A POSITIVE ASSOCIATION When using essential oils with animals it is important to create a positive association with the oil. You can do this by applying the oil to yourself for the first few days of usage. This will allow your animal to begin to associate the blend with his/her person. When you are ready to apply the blend to your animal or begin active diffusion you can reinforce the positive experience by doing something they love, like giving them their favorite treat or using a message application before bedtime.

description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

Directions for Use:

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

Cautions:

If pregnant, nursing or under a doctor’s care, consult the physician. Discontinue use if skin sensitivity occurs. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use undiluted on the skin. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin or on abrasions.

IMPORTANT: All of our products are for external use only.

Packing:

Gardenia Oil available in 8 packing options (5ml, 10ml, 15ml, 30ml, 50ml, 100ml, 250ml & 1000ml) which is Packed in Dark Colored Amber Glass Bottle (5ml - 100ml) with Euro Dropper, whereas 250ml,500ml & 1000ml comes in Aluminum Bottle.

שמן אתרי ציטרונלה: שמקורו באינדונזיה, סין והודו, שמן אתרי ציטרונלה של טיפול צמחי מזוקק באדים מעלי הדשא הציטרונלה (Cymbopogon חורף I an an), כדי לייצר שמן אתרי שאין לו תוספים או חומרי מילוי. לציטרונלה יש ניחוח הדרים לימוני, למרות שהוא הרבה יותר רך מלימון אמיתי, עם גווני עץ עדינים.

שמן רב-תכליתי ופופולרי: ציטרונלה משמשת לעתים קרובות בסבונים ונרות בגלל הניחוח הרענן שלה. זה יכול לעזור לתמוך במערכת נשימה בריאה וגם לסייע בהירגעות. בשימוש מקומי, ציטרונלה יכולה להפוך את הזמן שלך לבלות בחוץ ליותר נעים. שמן אתרי זה משתלב היטב עם ברגמוט, ארז, גרניום, לבנדר, לימון, תפוז ואורן.

קל לשימוש: שלבו חלקים שווים של ציטרונלה, עשב לימון ועלי קינמון, הוסיפו למים או לוז מכשפה, ורססו מסביב להיקף כדי להפוך את ההתכנסויות שלכם לחמימות יותר. כדי לעזור לקדם סביבה נקייה בבית שלכם במהלך איומי מחלות עונתיים, לפזר חלקים שווים של ציטרונלה ועלי קינמון שמן אתרי לאוויר. הוסיפו שמן ציטרונלה חיוני לשמן המנשא האהוב עליכם כדי לעזור בזיעה בבית השחי. הוסיפו טיפה אחת של ציטרונלה ושתי טיפות של עץ התה לכף אחת של שמן קוקוס או ג'ל אלוורה לשימוש על ציפורני הרגליים המגניבות הנובעות מהיותו יחפים במקלחות משותפות או אזורי בריכת השחייה.

Ätherisches Citronella-Öl: aus Indonesien, China und Indien stammt das ätherische Öl der Pflanzentherapie Citronella wird dampfdestilliert aus den Blättern des Citronella Gras (Cymbopogon Winter I an us), um ein ätherisches Öl zu produzieren, das absolut keine Zusatzstoffe oder Füllstoffe enthält. Citronella hat einen zitronigen Zitrusduft, obwohl es viel weicher ist als die tatsächliche Zitrone, mit subtilen Holztönen.

Vielseitiges und beliebtes Öl: Citronella wird aufgrund seines frischen Duftes oft in Seifen und Kerzen verwendet. Es kann helfen, eine gesunde Atemwege zu unterstützen und auch in der Entspannung zu helfen. Mit topischer Anwendung kann Citronella Ihre Zeit im Freien angenehmer machen. Dieses ätherische Öl passt gut zu Bergamotte, Zedernholz, Geranie, Lavendel, Zitrone, Orange und Kiefer.

Einfach zu bedienen: Kombinieren Sie die gleichen Teile von Citronella, Zitronengras und Zimtblatt, fügen Sie Wasser oder Hamamelis hinzu und sprühen Sie den Rand, um Ihre Veranstaltungen im Freien angenehmer zu machen. Zur Förderung einer sauberen Umgebung in Ihrem Zuhause während saisonaler Krankheitsbedrohungen, verteilen Sie gleiche Teile von Zitronengras und Zimtblatt in die Luft. Fügen Sie ätherisches Zitronella-Öl zu Ihrem Lieblings-Trägeröl hinzu, um Achselschweiß zu helfen. Fügen Sie 1 Tropfen Zitronengras und 2 Tropfen Teebaum zu 1 Esslöffel Kokosöl oder Aloe Vera Gel hinzu, um auf flippigen Zehennägeln zu verwenden, die in gemeinsamen Duschen oder Schwimmbadbereichen barfuß sind.

description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

Directions for Use:

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

Cautions:

If pregnant, nursing or under a doctor’s care, consult the physician. Discontinue use if skin sensitivity occurs. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use undiluted on the skin. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin or on abrasions.

IMPORTANT: All of our products are for external use only.

description:
Description:

Scientific Name: Abelmoschus esculentus

Okra is a flowering plant that has been originated in India and various English speaking countries. It is also known as bhindi, lady’s fingers and bhendi. Botanically, it is called Abelmoschus esculentus and belongs to the family Malvaceae. It is mostly prized for the seed pods it produces. Okra has high content of Vitamin C, A, iron and calcium. The seeds of Okra are striated; hairy and round that could be used for oil extraction. In 1920, Baughman and Jamaienson analyzed that the seeds have 20% of oil so Solvent extraction method is suitable to extract oil instead of expelling. The resulted oil is bright yellow in color having a greenish tinge and a fragrant odor. This oil possesses Gama and Alfa tocopherols along with triglycerides. It is an excellent source of linoleic acid which is a polyunsaturated fatty acid that is a required nutrition for humans.

description:
Ambrette is an aromatic and medicinal plant in the Malvaceae family, which is native to India. These seeds have a sweet, flowery, heavy fragrance quite similar to that of musk. Despite its tropical origin the plant is frost hardy. The evergreen shrub grows well in India, and is cultivated in the West Indies, China and Indonesia. Its used as a spice in the East, and as a musk substitute in perfumery. In India it is popularly known as Mushkdana or Kasturi Bhendi.

Oil is extracted from the musky, kidney- shaped, fully ripened seeds. The oil should be allowed to mature for a few months before use in flavours or fragrances, to allow the fatty acid notes to subdue and a rich, sweet, floral-musky almost wine-like or brandy like odour to develop.

When ambrette uncrushed/whole seeds are distilled, a liquid essential oil is produced, the crushed seeds yield a solid (so called concrete), the latter oil contains a high amount of palmitic acid. A true concrete is also produced.

The name and appearance of the juniper berry is easily misunderstood.

People would consider it a member of the berry family, but it biologically belongs to the cypress family.

Its coniferous leaves and the gradually changing color from green to indigo of the ripened fruit are the evidence.

The world-famous spirit Gin was made of distilled crop fermentation blended with juniper berries along with many other spices.

With superior effect on sterilization, juniper berry is expert of sterilization backed up by historical records.

Its various usages were even found in ancient Egyptian tombs, and serves as an essential element in the ritual of ancient European exorcism.

Other than usages related to religious cultures, hospitals and caring centers in France had applied it in serialization in early times.

Ripe indigo colored fruit is the primary source of the juniper berry essential oil.

There are cases using branches and conifer leaves as raw materials, however the quality and effects are not as good as the ones extracted from the juniper berry fruit.

description:
Ginger has been regarded as an indispensable food and medication by many races.

In Taiwan, it's the spice and seasoning most commonly seen in the household; it's also one of the most prevalent herbal medicines.

Ginger has a feature of giving off warmth and is easily absorbed during digestion, so it's often used to help resist chilling weather and to nourish the body.

The plantation of ginger needs to strictly focus organic cultivation and the rehabilitation of soil.

Ginger's full growing season is 10 months.

During the growing period, it absorbs large amounts of nutrients from the soil, and is a crop that consumes a lot of farm land.

Consequently, after the harvest of ginger, the land must go through the process of rehabilitation for the next plantation.

During the planting process, many farmers will use chemical pesticides and chemical fertilizers only for their convenience.

That method prepares the land for crops for a year, but it takes 3-5 years or more time to eliminate all the chemical ingredients and help the land regain nutrients.

It’s a method that causes the waste of land production , water loss and soil erosion; furthermore, the chemicals can’t be removed completely from the soil.

On the contrary, ginger farms cultivating through organic methods and fertilizing with organic vegetables, also strictly choose germ-free ginger species.

The farm land goes through a time-consuming plantation process, including exposure in the sun, water control management, and manual checks, so that without wasting the farm land, the annual harvest reaches a high quality, and the ginger has sufficient nutrients.

However, the cost or organic plantation is much higher than traditional agricultural methods.

Diffuser

Essential oils are placed in diffuser, sometimes with water, and sometimes with heat so they evaporate.

Dry evaporation

Spray

Massage

Main Chemical Components: beta-Bisabolene (15.02%), cis-alpha-bergamotene (11.12%), 10-epi-gamma-eudesmol (1.57%), gamma-eudesmol (1.04%), Botanical Name: Aquilaria Crassna/Country of Origin: Laos, Plant Part: Fungus Infected Wood / Method of Extraction: Steam Distilled(Distillation Date:April 2013), Color/Consistency: Light Amber Color with Medium Thick Consistency, 5ml in Amber Glass European Dropper Bottle]
description:
Agarwood Essential Oil, also known as oud oil, is an extremely rare and precious oil extracted from trees in the Aquilaria family, which grow throughout northeastern India, Bhutan, and parts of southeast Asia. Miracle Botanicals Agarwood Essential Oil comes from the Aquilaria Crassna species in Laos.

Agarwood Essential Oil takes on a different aroma and character over time. Older distillations tend to be more smooth and sweet compared to the pungent aroma of a fresh distilled oil. This Agarwood Essential Oil was distilled in 2013.

Agarwood Essential Oil is the result of a very unusual process. Normally, the heartwood of Aquilaria trees is light in color and doesn't have a strong aroma. However, when the wood is infected by a specific kind of mold, the tree produces an oleoresin as that saturates the wood as a defense mechanism, giving it a very dark color and the unique aroma.

Agarwood Essential Oil is one of the rarest and most expensive natural products in the world. A part of this is due to the small number of remaining trees that can produce this kind of oil, and another part is due to the complex and long-running process that's needed for the oil to be created.

Specific Benefits of Agarwood Essential Oil as follows:

Clearing and strengthening the mind... Agarwood has long been used for spiritual purposes, and is mentioned in the sacred texts of all the major world religions. It illuminates the mind, strengthens concentration, and can clear the mind of negative or oppressive thoughts.

Aphrodisiac... Agarwood or oud oil is believed to be one of the most powerful natural aphrodisiacs, stoking passion and desire, releasing common sexual problems, and increasing natural playfulness and enjoyment.

Relieving joint pain... Agarwood contains analgesic and anti-inflammatory substances that make it an ideal aid in case of chronic joint aches and pains

How is the oil extracted/processed?

Our organic sweet orange essential oil is cold-pressed from the outer layer of fresh, organic oranges grown in Mexico. That means, it's extracted without the use of heat, hexanes or harsh chemicals to preserve its fresh, energizing fragrance.

Can I use it in skincare blends?

You can! When using our pure orange essential oil for skin favorites like a scrub or cleanser, there a few important things to note: First, dilute it so that it makes up 2-5% of the blend (as a rule of thumb, that's about 12-30 drops per 1 oz of oil). Also, since sweet orange essential oil can make your skin sensitive to sunlight, it's great to use it at nighttime (so your skin's away from UV rays for up to 12 hours).

하루를 시작하거나 끝낼 수 있는 멋진 방법입니다. 아침에 일어날 수 있고 또는 긴 하루가 끝나면 향기로운 커피의 맛있는 향기로 기분을 높일 수 있다고 상상해보세요. 저희 전문가들은 아침에 가장 먼저 확산시켜서 하루를 활기찬 부스트로 시작할 것을 권장합니다. 또는 아침에 샤워나 목욕에 몇 방울을 떨어뜨려 활력을 주는 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 방을 탈취하고 동시에 기분을 들어올리세요! 디퓨저에 몇 방울을 넣고 공기에 에너지를 주입합니다.

알고 계셨나요? 커피는 탈모를 예방하는 도구인가요? 믿거나 말거나, 모발 성장에 도움이 됩니다. 샴푸에 추가하거나 캐리어 오일로 희석하고 두피에 3 ~ 4 방울을 마사지하여 그 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

멋진 라떼를 좋아한다면 에센셜 오일 블렌드를 만드는 것을 좋아할 것입니다.

오후나 저녁에 편안하고 상쾌한 향을 위해 커피 오일, 헬리크리섬, 바닐라(Co2 또는 올레오레진)을 섞어 보세요. 이 오일은 다음과 잘 어울립니다. 베르가못, 시더우드(히말라야), 네롤리, 샌달우드 호주안, 쁘띠그레인, 로즈 앱솔루트 및 주니퍼 베리.

기분을 높이거나 하루를 활기차게 만드세요.
공예가, 비누나 양초에 커피 오일을 추가하세요. 인생의 커피 광신자들을 위한 특별한 선물을 만들어 보세요. 냄새를 없애고 영혼을 들어 올리세요. 좋아하는 아침 향기를 즐기면서 치료적 이점을 누릴 수 있습니다. 이보다 더 좋을 수는 없습니다!

  • Steam Inhalation
    Fill a large container with almost boiling water and add 4-5 drops of essential oil or essential oil blend. Lean over the bowl and breathe slowly and deeply for a few minutes until relief is felt. A towel may be placed over the head to help direct the vapors.

    For the Ultra Sonic Essential Oil Diffusers, add water to the internal chamber and add 4-8 drops of essential oil(s).

When used properly essential oils and aromatherapy products are safe and effective for the entire family.

Essential oil is a natural product extracted from a single plant species. Not all plants produce essential oils, and in the plants that do, the essential oil may be found in the roots, stems, leaves, flowers, or fruits. Essential oils are concentrated plant extracts that retain the natural smell and flavor, or "essence," of their source.

ברוש יכול להיות שימושי עבור בעיות עור מסוימות כגון אקנה. יש לו תכונות אנטי דלקתיות, אנטיבקטריאליות וחריפות מה שהופך אותו למועיל לעור שמנוני, נוטה לפגמים. הוא יכול לשמש גם עבור דליות ורידים, בדילול של 2-3% חל על האזור הפגוע 2-3 פעמים ביום.

אנחנו עובדים ישירות עם מומחים מובילים. רוברט טיסרנד הוא מומחה ומומחה לשמנים אתריים הידוע בעולם. יש לנו אותו בודק באופן אורגני כל שמן אתרי לפני שהוא נשלח למעבדה של צד שלישי אחר עבור כרומטוגרפיה גז וספקטרומטריית המונים (הידוע גם בשם בדיקות GC/M).

ההבדל בטיפול בצמחים:
• 100% טהור ולא מדולל, מאושר על ידי משרד החקלאות האמריקאי אורגני, לא מהונדס גנטית
• בדיקת אורגנולפטית ו- GC/MS
• קודי אצווה על כל בקבוק
אנו מציעים מבחר עצום של שמנים ותערובות במגוון גדלים. הגדלים של 2.5 מ"ל, 5 מ"ל ו-10 מ"ל הם הכמות המושלמת כדי לבדוק את המים. בקבוק 30 מ"ל שלנו הוא בגודל פופולרי עבור אלה שיודעים עד כמה טוב השמנים שלנו עובדים. גודל הערך של 100 מ"ל הוא חסכוני וקל על התקציב. לנוחות אולטימטיבית, נסו את ה-Roll-Ons המוכנים לשימוש שלנו.

زيت السيبرس العطري من بلانت ثيرابي (مكونات INCI: زيت أوراق نبات الكوبريسوس سيمبرفيرنز ) السرو هو أحد أكثر الزيوت العطرية شعبية التي تقدمها بلانت ثيرابي ولأسباب وجيهة. إنه متعدد الاستخدامات للغاية وله العديد من الاستخدامات. يتميز السرو برائحة جميلة وخشبية منعشة قليلاً مصنوعة بواسطة تقطير أوراق شجر السرو بالبخار في إسبانيا. السرو رائع للمساعدة في دعم الجهاز التنفسي الصحي طوال العام. سواء كنت تعاني من الحساسية أو موسم البرد أو الإنفلونزا، فإن سايبرس هنا للمساعدة. انشره للمساعدة في تنظيف الجيوب الأنفية أو عمل مزيل للاحتقان الموضعي الطبيعي وضعه على الصدر لمزيد من الراحة.

يمكن أن تساعدك رائحة السيبرس المهدئة والمنعشة عندما تكون الأوقات قاسية أو في النفايات. خذ بعض الاستنشاق العميق من الرائحة العشبية المنعشة وابدأ في الشعور بموجة من الهدوء في جميع أنحاء جسمك.

السرو يمكن أن يكون مفيدًا لمشاكل معينة في البشرة مثل حب الشباب. يتميز بخصائص مضادة للالتهابات والبكتيريا وقابضة مما يجعله مفيدًا للبشرة الدهنية المعرضة للشوائب. يمكن استخدامه أيضًا للدوالي الوريدية، في وضع تخفيف 2-3% على المنطقة المتضررة 2-3 مرات يوميًا.

نعمل مباشرة مع أفضل الخبراء. روبرت تيسراند، خبير ومعلم في الزيوت العطرية مشهور عالميًا. نجعله يقوم باختبار كل زيت عطري عضويًا قبل إرساله إلى مختبر آخر طرف ثالث لتنسيق الغاز وقياس الكتلة الطيفية (المعروف أيضًا باسم اختبار GC/MSM).

اختلاف العلاج النباتي:
• نقي 100% وغير مخفف، عضوي معتمد من وزارة الزراعة الأمريكية، غير معدل وراثياً.
• اختبار الحواس والغاز/القياس الكتلي
• ادفع الرموز على كل زجاجة.
نقدم مجموعة واسعة من الزيوت والخلطات بأحجام مختلفة. الأحجام 2.5 مل و5 مل و10 مل هي الكمية المثالية لاختبار الماء. زجاجة 30 مل الخاصة بنا ذات حجم شائع لأولئك الذين يعرفون مدى عمل زيوتنا. حجم القيمة 100 مل فعال من حيث التكلفة وسهل في التكلفة. للحصول على أقصى درجات الراحة، جرّب منتجاتنا الدوارة الجاهزة للاستخدام.

O óleo essencial de cipreste da Plant Therapy (ingredientes INCI: Óleo de folha de Cupressus Sempervirens) O cipreste é um dos óleos essenciais mais populares oferecidos pela Plant Therapy e por um bom motivo. É ultra versátil e tem muitos usos. O cipreste tem um belo aroma picante e ligeiramente amadeirado que é feito com folhas de destilação a vapor de cipreste na Espanha. O cipreste é ótimo para ajudar a apoiar um sistema respiratório saudável durante todo o ano. Se você estiver lidando com alergias ou está na estação fria/gripe, o cipreste está aqui para ajudar. Difunda para ajudar a clarear os seios nasais ou fazer um descongestionante tópico natural e aplique no peito para ainda mais alívio.

O aroma calmante e revigorante do cipreste pode ajudar você quando os tempos estiverem difíceis ou você estiver no lixo. Tire algumas profundas inalações do aroma herbáceo e fresco e comece a sentir uma onda de calma em todo o seu corpo.

O cipreste pode ser útil para certos problemas de pele como acne. Tem propriedades anti-inflamatórias, antibacterianas e adstringentes, o que o torna útil para peles oleosas e propensas a manchas. Também pode ser usado para varizes, em uma diluição de 2 a 3%, aplique na área afetada 2 a 3 vezes ao dia.

Trabalhamos diretamente com os melhores especialistas. Robert Tisserand é um especialista e educador de óleos essenciais de renome mundial. Fazemos com que ele teste organolepticamente cada óleo essencial antes de ser enviado para outro laboratório de terceiros de cromatografia a gás e espectrometria de massa (também conhecido como teste GC/MS).

A diferença da Plant Therapy:
• 100% puro e não diluído, certificado orgânico USDA, sem OGM
• Testes organolépticos e GC/MS
• Códigos de lote em cada garrafa
Oferecemos uma vasta seleção de óleos e misturas em uma variedade de tamanhos. Os tamanhos de 2,5 ml, 5 ml e 10 ml são a quantidade perfeita para testar as águas. Nosso frasco de 30 ml tem um tamanho popular para aqueles que sabem o quão bem nossos óleos funcionam. O valor de 100 ml é econômico e fácil de usar no orçamento. Para a máxima conveniência, experimente nossos Roll-On prontos para usar.

Plant Therapy 柏樹精油(INCI 成分:Cupressus Sempervirens Leaf Oil) 柏樹是 Plant Therapy 提供最受歡迎的精油之一,有很好的理由。 超多功能,用途廣泛。 Cypress 有一種美麗的辛辣、微木清新香味,由西班牙柏樹蒸餾葉製成。Cypress 非常適合全年維持健康的呼吸系統。 無論您是應對過敏或寒冷 / 流感季節,Cypress 隨時為您提供協助。 擴散以幫助清除鼻竇或形成自然局部減充血劑,並塗抹在胸部以得到更多緩解。

Cypress 的舒緩、令人振奮的香氣可以幫助您在時間緊張或您在垃圾桶中。 吸收一些強烈的草本清新香味,開始感覺整個身體平靜。 ​

Cypress 可以用於某些皮膚問題,如痤瘡。 它具有抗炎、抗菌和收腰特性,有助於油性、易產生瑕疵的肌膚。 它也可以用於靜脈曲張,稀釋 2-3% 適用於受影響區域,每天 2-3 次。

我們直接與頂級專家合作。 Robert Tisserand 是世界知名的精油專家和教育家。 我們讓他對每種精油進行器官測試,然後再送至另一個第三方實驗室進行氣相色譜和質譜 (也稱為 GC/MS 測試)。

植物療法的不同之處:
• 100% 純淨未稀釋,USDA 認證有機,非轉基因
• 器官和 GC/MS 測試
• 每個瓶子上的批碼
我們提供各種尺寸的精油和混合物。 2.5 毫升、5 毫升和 10 毫升的尺寸是測試水的完美量。 我們的 30 毫升瓶是一款熱門尺寸,適合那些知道精油運作狀況的人。 100 毫升的尺寸經濟實惠,價格實惠。 為了極致方便,請試試我們隨時可用的Roll-On。

Plant Therapy 柏树精油(INCI 成分:Cupressus Sempervirens 叶油)柏树是Plant Therapy所提供的广受欢迎的精油之一。 超百搭,用途广泛。 柏树有一种美丽辛辣,微木香的清香,由西班牙柏树的蒸汽蒸馏叶制成。柏树有助于全年保持健康的呼吸系统。 无论您是面对过敏还是感冒/流感季节,Cypress 都能为您提供帮助。 扩散以帮助清除鼻窦或制作天然局部脱血剂,并涂抹在胸部,以获得更多缓解。

Cypress 舒缓、令人振奋的香气可以帮助您在时光艰难或您进入水槽时为您提供帮助。 深吸一些草本清新的香味,开始在整个身体中感受平静的波浪。

柏树对某些皮肤问题有帮助。 它具有抗炎、抗菌和收敛特性,有助于油性、易长痘的皮肤。 它还可以用于静脉曲张,2-3% 的稀释剂在受影响区域每天 2-3 次。

我们直接与顶级专家合作。 Robert Tisserand 是世界著名的精油专家和教育家。 在送到另一个第三方实验室进行气体色谱和质量光谱测量(也称 GC/MS 测试)之前,我们让他有机地测试每一种精油。

植物治疗的与众不同之处:
• 100% 纯和未稀释,USDA Organic 认证,非转基因
• 有机和 GC/MS 测试

我们提供各种尺寸的油和混合物。 2.5 毫升、5 毫升和 10 毫升的尺寸是测试水份的完美量。 对于那些知道我们油工作质量的人来说,我们的 30 毫升瓶是一种受欢迎的尺寸。 100 毫升的超值尺寸经济实惠,预算更简单。 为了获得极致便利,请尝试我们随时可用的滚珠。

플랜트 테라피 사이프러스 에센셜 오일 (INCI 성분: Cupressus Sempervirens 잎 오일) 사이프러스는 플랜트 테라피가 제공하는 가장 인기 있는 에센셜 오일 중 하나이며, 좋은 이유가 있습니다. 매우 다재다능하며 많은 용도가 있습니다. 사이프러스는 스페인의 사이프러스 나무의 증기로 잎을 증류하여 만든 아름답고 매운 약간 우디한 신선한 향기를 가지고 있습니다. 사이프러스는 일 년 내내 건강한 호흡기 시스템을 지원하는 데 좋습니다. 알레르기를 겪거나 추위/독감 시즌에 상관없이 사이프러스가 도와드리겠습니다. 부비동을 없애거나 자연스러운 국소 충혈 완화제를 만들고 가슴에 바르면 더욱 완화됩니다.

사이프러스의 진정 효과가 있는 향은 시간이 힘들거나 덤프를 할 때 도움이 됩니다. 초본의 신선한 향기를 깊게 들으며 몸 전체에 차분한 물결을 느끼기 시작하십시오.

사이프러스는 여드름과 같은 특정 피부 문제에 유용합니다. 항염증, 항균 및 수렴 기능이 있어 지성 및 잡티가 많은 피부에 유용합니다. 또한 정맥류에도 사용할 수 있습니다. 2-3% 희석하여 손상된 부위에 매일 2-3번 바르세요.

우리는 최고의 전문가들과 직접 일합니다. Robert Tisserand는 세계적으로 유명한 에센셜 오일 전문가이자 교육자입니다. 우리는 가스 크로마토그래피 및 질량 분광 측정(GC/MS 테스트라고도 함)을 위해 다른 제3자 실험실로 보내기 전에 각 에센셜 오일을 관능적으로 테스트했습니다.

식물 치료의 차이점:
• 100% 순수 및 희석되지 않은 USDA 인증 유기농, GMO 프리.
• Organoleptic 및 GC/MS 테스트
• 모든 병에 배치 코드
저희는 다양한 크기의 오일 및 블렌드를 광범위하게 선택할 수 있습니다. 2.5 mL, 5 mL 및 10 ml 사이즈는 물을 테스트하기에 완벽한 양입니다. 저희 30mL 병은 오일의 효과가 얼마나 잘 알고 있는 사람들에게 인기 있는 크기입니다. 100mL 값 사이즈는 비용 효율적이며 예산에 부담이 없습니다. 최상의 편의를 위해 바로 사용할 수 있는 롤온을 사용해보세요.

description:
100% PURE ORGANIC CINNAMON CASSIA ESSENTIAL OIL
Originating from China, Plant Therapy’s Organic Cinnamon Cassia (Cinnamomum cassia) Essential Oil is steam distilled from the bark of the Chinese Cinnamon tree to produce a USDA Certified Organic essential oil that has absolutely no additives or fillers. This incredible oil is known for its warm, spicy scent with a hint of sweetness and therapeutic properties.

AN ESSENTIAL OIL FAVORITE
Organic Cinnamon Cassia is known to support a healthy immune system and to encourage healthy feelings of self esteem. Organic Cinnamon Cassia Oil can be used as a warming blend as long as great care is used when diluting, as it can easily irritate the skin. The scent of Cinnamon Cassia Organic Oil is reminiscent of the winter holidays, particularly when combined with complementary oils such as Clove Bud and Orange Sweet .

EASY TO USE
Diffuse Organic Cinnamon Cassia Oil to promote a strong sense of self-worth. For a warming blend, dilute one drop of oil in two ounces of carrier oil and massage into affected areas. Create your own potpourri by scenting pine cones with Organic Cinnamon Cassia, Clove Bud, and Orange Sweet Oils. We recommend a maximum dilution of 0.05% for topical applications. This can cause skin irritant so use on a small patch of skin before applying in larger areas.

AFFORDABLE, HIGH-QUALITY ESSENTIAL OILS

The oil is distilled from the leaves of the tea tree plant (Melaleuca Alternifolia) and contains absolutely no additives or fillers. Ätherisches Teebaumöl (INCI: Melaleuca Alternifolia (Teebaum) Blattöl)

Plant Therapy's Teebaumöl ist eines der weltweit bekanntesten und beliebtesten ätherischen Öle. Das Öl wird aus den Blättern der Teebaumpflanze (Melaleuca Alternifolia) destilliert und enthält absolut keine Zusatzstoffe oder Füllstoffe. Unser ätherisches Melaleuca Öl ist bekannt für sein frisches, beruhigendes, grünes holziges Aroma und seine außergewöhnlichen therapeutischen Eigenschaften. Diese Eigenschaften machen es zu einer großartigen Wahl für die Aromatherapie. Er vermittelt einen frischen, grünen holzigen Duft und ist die perfekte Ergänzung zu einem hausgemachten Haushaltsreiniger, besonders für dampfig muffige Bereiche wie das Badezimmer. Sie können Teebaumöl entweder mit Ihrem natürlichen Lieblings-Oberflächenreiniger verdünnen oder das Öl allein verteilen, oder mit einem Blumenöl wie Jasmin Absolute oder Lavendel. Plant Therapy's ätherisches Teebaumöl ist eine tolle Ergänzung für Körperpflegeprodukte und für alle, die nach Melaleuca Produkten suchen. Das Öl hat bemerkenswerte Auswirkungen auf Hautunreinheiten und gereizte Haut. Ein paar Tropfen des Öls können Rötungen lindern, Glätte wiederherstellen und die der Sonne überbelassene Haut beruhigen. Es ist auch ideal zum Entfernen von Hautunreinheiten. Erstellen Sie eine hautberuhigende Salbe, indem Sie gleiche Teile Teebaum, Lavendel und Zitrone mit 2 EL Ihres Lieblingspflanzenträgeröls mischen. Dann fügen Sie es zu den Gebieten hinzu. Für die topische Anwendung auf dem Gesicht auf 1% verdünnen. Es bietet auch Unterstützung des Immunsystems.

description:
Essential oils are natural aromatic compounds found in the seeds, bark, stems, roots, flowers, and other parts of plants. They can be both beautifully and powerfully fragrant. If you have ever enjoyed the gift of a rose, a walk by a field of lavender, or the smell of fresh cut mint, you have experienced the aromatic qualities of essential oils. In addition to giving plants their distinctive smells, essential oils provide plants with protection against predators and disease and play a role in plant pollination.
Essential oils are non water-based phytochemicals made up of volatile aromatic compounds. Although they are fat soluble, they do not include fatty lipids or acids found in vegetable and animal oils. Essential oils are very clean, almost crisp, to the touch and are immediately absorbed by the skin.
In addition to their intrinsic benefits to plants and being beautifully fragrant to people, essential oils have been used throughout history in many cultures for their medicinal and therapeutic benefits. Modern scientific study and trends toward more holistic approaches to wellness are driving a revival and new discovery of essential oil health applications.

description: Scent Name: Banana Size: 5mL WHAT ARE TERPENES? Plants consist of a wide variety of chemicals and compounds. Roughly 20,000 of these compounds reside in a category of essential oils referred to as terpenes. These organic agents are what give fruits, herbs, and flowers their own specific scent and flavor. Terpenes also create a synergistic alliance with compounds found in the human body as well as other chemicals within the plant, this union is know as the “entourage effect”, which magnifies the benefits of the plant’s components. WHAT ARE TERPENES USED FOR? Terpenes can be used in foods, cocktails and other drinks, sauces, teas, extracts, etc. to enhance the flavor or scent of the product as well as the overall experience for the user. ARE TERPENES SAFE TO CONSUME? Anything Food Grade or GenerallyRecognized As Safe (GRAS) terpenes are safe to use as flavor ingredients as long as they have been diluted prior to use. Our terpenes are highly concentrated, for this reason we recommend starting a 3% or 1-2 drops per gram. WHY ARE TERPENES IMPORTANT? Terpenes work together with other compounds to provide not just a scent or a flavor, but anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. In some cases, the terpenes help to magnify the effects of other compounds involved. HOW LONG DO THE EFFECTS OF TERPENES LAST? 6. Rosemary Oil - Rosemary oil can help discourage hair loss and boost growth instead. It also boosts memory, lowers cortisol and helps with its antioxidant properties.
7. Lemongrass Oil - Lemongrass oil has been known to relieve headaches, fight germs, deodorize, lift spirits, and boost energy levels.
8. Sweet Orange Oil - Sweet orange oil, along with its great scent, can help with skin and healing for your mouth and gums. It can also be used in aromatherapy as a mood lifter to help relieve stress.

When you are ready to apply the blend to your animal or begin active diffusion you can reinforce the positive experience by doing something they love, like giving them their favorite treat or using a message application before bedtime.

קל לשימוש: שלבו חלקים שווים של ציטרונלה, עשב לימון ועלי קינמון, הוסיפו למים או לוז מכשפה, ורססו מסביב להיקף כדי להפוך את ההתכנסויות שלכם לחמימות יותר. כדי לעזור לקדם סביבה נקייה בבית שלכם במהלך איומי מחלות עונתיים, לפזר חלקים שווים של ציטרונלה ועלי קינמון שמן אתרי לאוויר. הוסיפו שמן ציטרונלה חיוני לשמן המנשא האהוב עליכם כדי לעזור בזיעה בבית השחי. הוסיפו טיפה אחת של ציטרונלה ושתי טיפות של עץ התה לכף אחת של שמן קוקוס או ג'ל אלוורה לשימוש על ציפורני הרגליים המגניבות הנובעות מהיותו יחפים במקלחות משותפות או אזורי בריכת השחייה.

איכות גבוהה במחיר סביר: המטרה שלנו ב-Plant Therapy היא להשפיע באופן חיובי על חייהם של אנשים רבים ככל האפשר. על ידי מכירת מוצר כזה באיכות גבוהה במחיר סביר, אנו לא רק משפיעים באופן חיובי על חייהם של הלקוחות שלנו, אלא גם נותן לנו את האמצעים הכלכליים שבאמצעותם אנו יכולים לעזור לאלה שהם פחות ברי מזל לחיות חיים מאושרים יותר, בריאים יותר ויעילים יותר.

Ätherisches Citronella-Öl: aus Indonesien, China und Indien stammt das ätherische Öl der Pflanzentherapie Citronella wird dampfdestilliert aus den Blättern des Citronella Gras (Cymbopogon Winter I an us), um ein ätherisches Öl zu produzieren, das absolut keine Zusatzstoffe oder Füllstoffe enthält. Citronella hat einen zitronigen Zitrusduft, obwohl es viel weicher ist als die tatsächliche Zitrone, mit subtilen Holztönen.

Vielseitiges und beliebtes Öl: Citronella wird aufgrund seines frischen Duftes oft in Seifen und Kerzen verwendet. Es kann helfen, eine gesunde Atemwege zu unterstützen und auch in der Entspannung zu helfen. Mit topischer Anwendung kann Citronella Ihre Zeit im Freien angenehmer machen. Dieses ätherische Öl passt gut zu Bergamotte, Zedernholz, Geranie, Lavendel, Zitrone, Orange und Kiefer.

Einfach zu bedienen: Kombinieren Sie die gleichen Teile von Citronella, Zitronengras und Zimtblatt, fügen Sie Wasser oder Hamamelis hinzu und sprühen Sie den Rand, um Ihre Veranstaltungen im Freien angenehmer zu machen. Zur Förderung einer sauberen Umgebung in Ihrem Zuhause während saisonaler Krankheitsbedrohungen, verteilen Sie gleiche Teile von Zitronengras und Zimtblatt in die Luft. Fügen Sie ätherisches Zitronella-Öl zu Ihrem Lieblings-Trägeröl hinzu, um Achselschweiß zu helfen. Fügen Sie 1 Tropfen Zitronengras und 2 Tropfen Teebaum zu 1 Esslöffel Kokosöl oder Aloe Vera Gel hinzu, um auf flippigen Zehennägeln zu verwenden, die in gemeinsamen Duschen oder Schwimmbadbereichen barfuß sind.

زيت السترونيلا العطري: من إندونيسيا والصين والهند، يتم تقطير زيت سيترونيلا العطري في العلاج النباتي بالبخار من أوراق عشب السيترونيلا (سيمبوبوجون وينتر I وus)، لإنتاج زيت عطري لا يحتوي على أي إضافات أو حشوات. يتميز سيترونيلا برائحة الليمون الحمضية، على الرغم من أنه أكثر نعومة من الليمون الفعلي، مع درجات خشبية رقيقة.

زيت شائع ومتعدد الاستخدامات: غالبًا ما يستخدم السيترونيلا في الصابون والشموع بسبب رائحته المنعشة. يمكن أن يساعد على دعم الجهاز التنفسي الصحي ويساعد أيضًا على الاسترخاء. يمكن أن يجعل السيترونيلا الوقت الذي تقضيه في الهواء الطلق أكثر متعة. يمتزج هذا الزيت العطري جيدًا مع البرغموت وخشب الأرز وإبرة الراعي واللافندر والليمون والبرتقال والصنوبر.

سهلة الاستخدام: اجمع بين أجزاء متساوية من السيترونيلا وعشب الليمون وأوراق القرفة، أضف إلى الماء أو بندق الساحرة ورش حول المحيط لجعل التجمعات الخارجية أكثر متعة. للمساعدة في تعزيز بيئة نظيفة في منزلك خلال مخاطر الأمراض الموسمية ، قم بتوزيع أجزاء متساوية من الزيت العطري وأوراق السيترونيلا والقرفة في الهواء. أضف زيت سيترونيلا العطري إلى زيتك الناقل المفضل للمساعدة في التخلص من العرق تحت الإبط. أضف قطرة واحدة من السيترونيلا وقطرتين من شجرة الشاي إلى ملعقة كبيرة من زيت جوز الهند أو جل الصبار لاستخدامها على أظافر القدم غير التقليدية التي تنتج عن كونها حافي القدمين في مناطق الاستحمام المشتركة أو حمام السباحة.

جودة عالية بسعر في متناول اليد: هدفنا في بلانت ثيرابي هو التأثير بشكل إيجابي على حياة أكبر عدد ممكن من الأشخاص. من خلال بيع مثل هذا المنتج عالي الجودة بأسعار في متناول الجميع، نحن لا نؤثر بشكل إيجابي على حياة عملائنا فحسب، بل يمنحنا أيضًا الإمكانيات المالية التي يمكننا من خلالها مساعدة أولئك الذين تقل حظًا في العيش حياة أكثر سعادة وصحة وإنتاجية.

Óleo essencial de citronela: originário da Indonésia, China e Índia, o óleo essencial de citronela da Plant Therapy é destilado a vapor das folhas da grama de citronela (Cymbopogon Winter I an us), para produzir um óleo essencial que não tem absolutamente nenhum aditivo ou enchimento. A citronela tem um aroma cítrico de limão, embora seja muito mais suave do que o limão real, com tons de madeira sutis.

Óleo versátil e popular: a citronela é frequentemente usada em sabonetes e velas devido ao seu aroma fresco. Pode ajudar a apoiar um sistema respiratório saudável e também ajudar no relaxamento. Usado tópicamente, a citronela pode tornar o seu tempo gasto ao ar livre mais agradável. Este óleo essencial combina bem com bergamota, cedro, gerânio, lavanda, limão, laranja e pinheiro.

Fácil de usar: combine partes iguais de citronela, capim-limão e folha de canela, adicione água ou avelã e pulverize ao redor do perímetro para tornar seus encontros ao ar livre mais agradáveis. Para ajudar a promover um ambiente limpo em sua casa durante ameaças de doenças sazonais, difunda partes iguais de citronela e óleo essencial de folha de canela no ar. Adicione óleo essencial de citronela ao seu óleo base favorito para ajudar com a transpiração nas axilas. Adicione 1 gota de citronela e 2 gotas de árvore do chá a 1 colher de sopa de óleo de coco ou gel de Aloe Vera para usar em unhas modernas que resultam de estar descalço em chuveiros ou áreas de piscina compartilhadas.

百搭和流行精油:香茅精油因其清新的香味而常用于肥皂和蜡烛。 它有助于支持健康的呼吸系统,并有助于放松。 话题使用香茅,可以让您的户外时光更加愉悦。 这款精油与佛手柑、雪松木、天竺葵、薰衣草、柠檬、橙子和松木混合。

description:
100% Pure, Natural & Therapeutic Grade Gardenia Essential Oil - 5ml to 1000ml

Botanical Name: Gardenia jasminoides.

Collection Method: Enfleurage.

Plant Part: Flowers.

Aromatic Description: It has a rich, sweet floral aroma.

Strength of Aroma: Medium.

Plant Family: Rubiaceae.

Common Name: Cape jasmine, danh-danh, gardenia radicans, cape jessamine, gandhraj.

Origin: India.

Gardenia jasminoides is the botanical name of Gardenia Essential Oil which is extracted from the flowers of Gardenia through enfleurage process in which flower petals are soaked in fat, which absorbs most of the aromatic constituents of the petals. Then the aromatic fat is washed with alcohol to dissolve the fragrant molecules into the alcohol. Finally, the alcohol is separated from the fat and allowed to evaporate, leaving behind the Gardenia absolute. It has a characteristic sweet aroma that sees it feature as an important ingredient in perfumery and aromatherapy. It is also referred to as "White Angel".

. Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of your choice. . Topical use: Apply one to two drops to the desired area.

This yellow-brown essential oil is steam distilled from an herb native to southern India and has a potent, fruity odor. The leafy green plant, which grows 12-18 inches tall and sports tiny, puffy yellow flowers, is revered by the people of the area who use the flowers in religious or ceremonial offerings. The whole plant is distilled right before the flowers open.


Traditionally, Ayurvedic healers in India have long used the herb for all manner of women's reproductive issues, from helping to support regular menses to easing menopausal concerns. Davana can also assist with minor sniffles and people there often apply it to the skin when encountering life's minor lumps and bumps. There is a popular folk belief that while Davana smells the same to everyone while in the bottle, it takes on a different individual fragrance of its own depending on who is wearing it.


In modern times, Davana is popular in perfumery to provide a fruity top-note. Davana really shines when used for emotional concerns. When life really gets to us, it soothes the nerves, restores emotional calm, and is exceptional for quieting the mind.

What is Frankincense?

Many know of Frankincense as one of the plant-derived treasures, along with myrrh, given to the newborn Jesus in the New Testament. Its use in a religious context goes beyond Christianity, however. According to the Hebrew Bible, frankincense and myrrh were components of the holy incense ritually burned in Jerusalem’s sacred temples during ancient times.

Frankincense is derived from the sap from a specific variety of trees in the genus Boswellia. Harvests are done at various times and the more opaque resins are considered to be the best quality.

Benefits of Frankincense oil

    The main chemical of Frankincense oil constituents of the essential oil are Limonene, Pinene, Borneol, Farnesol, Phellandrene, Myrcene, and other constituents. Limonene demonstrates antioxidant, anti-inflammatory those are believed to reduce feelings of anxiety and to stimulate the immune system. Used topically and cosmetically, its astringent and cytophylactic qualities help Frankincense oil to reduce the appearance of wrinkles and skin imperfections such as discoloration. description:
Our Premium Frankincense and Myrrh essential oil set contains the finest Frankincense of the Carterii variety and Myrrh essential oil.

– Frankincense Carterii Essential Oil is from the Boswellia Carterii tree, which grows in Somalia. It has traditionally been used as incense during religious rituals. Frankincense Carterii is the "traditional" Frankincense species, and is the source of the most common kind of Frankincense Essential Oil.

For a long time, there was debate whether this is actually the same species as Boswellia sacra. Recently, chemical analysis of the resin of the two plants has shown that these are indeed different species with different makeups and properties.

– Myrrh Essential Oil comes from the resin of a small tree that’s native to the Horn of Africa and that’s related to frankincense. It has been in use for religious and medicinal purposes for millennia, including in ancient Egypt and during Biblical times. Today, it remains one of the most popular essential oils.

In aromatherapy, myrrh is used to relax the body, uplift the emotions, and focus the mind.

This Myrrh essential oil is steam distilled, and is therefore slightly different from the CO2 Extracted Myrrh, which we also offer. Both versions of myrrh oil share many of the same therapeutic benefits. However, the two different extraction processes result in oils with slightly different aromas, colors, and consistencies.
